title: Product formula for the nonfalsification indicator
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $T$ be a DNF term on $n$ coordinates, and assign each coordinate one of the restrictions free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$. The real indicator of the event that $T$ is not falsified is the product, over all coordinates, of the local factors that are $0$ when the corresponding literal is falsified and $1$ otherwise; coordinates outside the support contribute $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a DNF term on $n$ coordinates
Each coordinate has a restriction chosen from free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$
